sources.title: Quantization of four-form fluxes and dynamical neutralization of the cosmological constant

sources.title: A derivation of quantum theory from physical requirements

sources.title: Dynamical Origin of Quantum Probabilities

sources.title: A survey of random processes with reinforcement

sources.title: Renormalization Group and Critical Phenomena. I. Renormalization Group and the Kadanoff Scaling Picture
sources.note: RG fixed points and universality; change of scale is not temporal law drift.

sources.title: Self-organized criticality: An explanation of the 1/f noise
sources.note: Original model class, not selection of physical fine-structure constant or action.

sources.title: Vacuum Energy Sequestering: The Framework and Its Cosmological Consequences

sources.title: Improved limits for violations of local position invariance from atomic clock comparisons

sources.title: Analysis of atomic-clock data to constrain variations of fundamental constants

sources.title: Fine-structure constant sensitivity of the Th-229 nuclear clock transition
sources.note: Primary title/date and search abstract inspected; PMC full-text was blocked by captcha. Sensitivity is not a detected variation.

sources.title: Emergence of a 4D World from Causal Quantum Gravity
sources.note: Effective geometry within specified causal triangulation ensemble; not a structure-free choice of microscopic dimension.
